pt.title: Pousada Enero · Pousada pé na areia em Maragogi
pt.desc: 28 suítes de frente para a praia em Maragogi, café da manhã em cesta de piquenique na areia, restaurante e pet friendly. Reserve direto com 17% de desconto.
pt.hero_eyebrow: Pousada pé na areia · Maragogi, Alagoas

en.title: Pousada Enero · Beachfront pousada in Maragogi
en.desc: 28 beachfront suites in Maragogi, picnic-basket breakfast on the sand, a restaurant and pet friendly. Book direct and save 17%.
en.hero_p: 28 suites a few steps from the sea, breakfast in a picnic basket and a restaurant on the sand. Pet friendly.
en.hero_alt_desk: Maragogi beach seen from the pousada through bougainvillea
en.rd_1p: Found it cheaper elsewhere within 24 hours? We match it and take another 10% off.
en.rd_2p: Deposit refunded if you cancel up to 14 days before check-in.
en.rd_3p: Special requests go straight to reception on WhatsApp.
en.rd_note: Opens the pousada's booking system with the discount already applied.
en.po_p: A beachfront pousada in Maragogi, among palm trees and natural pools. Simple and spotless: white linen, wood, thatch and the sea a few steps from your door.
en.po_alt1: The beach kiosk seen through a doorway
en.map_see: See the suites in this area
en.z_posada_p: The main building, facing the sand. Home to the sea-view suites.
en.z_deluxe_p: Suites with balconies, several with a sea view.
en.z_rest_p: Open to the public every day, 12 pm to 8:30 pm.
en.z_praia_p: Parasols, hammocks and loungers facing the sea. Trips to the natural pools leave from here, depending on the tide.
en.vm_alt: The sand seen through a suite doorway
en.ca_1p: Under the palms, in a hammock or facing the sea.
en.ca_2p: With sunflowers and a «bom dia» note with your name.
en.ca_3p: Fresh fruit, natural juices and homemade treats.
en.re_t: Good food with your toes in the sand.
en.re_p: Open to the public every day, 12 pm to 8:30 pm. Day use available.
en.pa_1p: By speedboat to Barra Grande and Caminho de Moisés.
en.pa_2p: To Croa de São Bento under a tricolour sail.
en.pa_4p: The local beaches from end to end.
en.pet_p: Pet friendly: one pet per suite. Let us know when you book and we’ll have everything ready.
en.pet_alt: White cat next to the breakfast basket
en.av_orig: Real guest reviews in their original language, via Booking.com
en.ch_addr: Av. Senador Rui Palmeira, 2190 · Maragogi, Alagoas, Brazil
en.q1: What are the check-in and check-out times?
en.a1: Check-in from 2 pm to 9 pm and check-out from 8 am to 12 pm. Reception is open 8 am to 9 pm.
en.a2: Yes, we are pet friendly: one pet per suite.
en.a3: Cancel up to 14 days before check-in and your deposit is refunded. After that there are no refunds or date changes.
en.a4: Yes, in the pousada's suites breakfast comes in the picnic basket. Casa Enero does not include breakfast.
en.ft_g2: Restaurant open to the public 12–8:30 pm
en.ft_g3: Pet friendly · one pet per suite
en.wa_text: Hi! I'd like some information about Pousada Enero.
en.js_dates: Pick a check-out date after check-in.
en.bot_hi: Hi! I’m Enero’s little boat. Pick a question and I’ll answer right away.
en.bot_human: For anything else, reception answers on WhatsApp from 8 am to 9 pm.
en.bot_a6: Book direct on our website and get 17% OFF every suite. Found it cheaper elsewhere within 24 hours? We match it and take another 10% off.
en.bot_a7: Av. Senador Rui Palmeira, 2190, Maragogi (Alagoas, Brazil), right on the sand, next to Salinas Resort.
en.bot_a8: Restaurante Enero is open every day from 12 pm to 8:30 pm, open to the public. Day use available too.
en.bot_a9: Natural pools, jangada and sailing trips leave from the beach, depending on the tide. Reception arranges everything for you.
en.ex_1p: Beachfront tables, hammocks, loungers and gardens, never crowded.
en.ex_2p: Pick your spot and the basket arrives with sunflowers and a bom dia note with your name.
en.ex_3p: Open to the public every day, 12 pm to 8:30 pm, with your toes in the sand.
